raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Fixes #47067

Add API key authentication to Diffusion HTTP and WebSocket endpoints using the existing SRT middleware and endpoint permission levels. This supersedes the closed PR #23244.

Management endpoints use `ADMIN_OPTIONAL`, matching SRT:
- No keys: normal and management endpoints remain open.
- API key only: both require the API key.
- Admin key only: normal endpoints remain open; management endpoints require the admin key.
- Both keys: normal endpoints require the API key; management endpoints require the admin key.

## Changes

- Add `--api-key` and `--admin-api-key` to Diffusion server arguments, excluding the keys from the server argument representation.
- Apply shared authentication to HTTP requests and WebSocket handshakes, and mark LoRA, weight management, and memory release/resume endpoints with `ADMIN_OPTIONAL`.
- Reject unauthorized WebSocket connections before acceptance using ASGI close code 1008 (HTTP 403 on the wire). This covers realtime video, Action, and OpenPI routes. The shared middleware also applies the same policy to SRT WebSocket routes.
- Resolve authentication metadata across supported FastAPI router layouts and keep `/liveness` public. Preserve upstream health/readiness/metrics and CORS preflight exemptions.
- Register CORS outside authentication so cross-origin clients can read authentication error responses.
- Add parser, HTTP authentication, and WebSocket handshake regression tests.
- Include the WebSocket dependency in the cross-platform Diffusion extra and restrict a NVIDIA-specific attention test to NVIDIA CUDA.

## Validation

Updated against upstream main `d8c28b123111a7de80ad5e559cd49b7b4c54161a` (2026-11-01). The auth implementation was also checked against the official `v0.5.23` source. The PR now changes eight files (+476/-26), including 384 lines in the authentication regression test file.

Latest follow-up: `4f1a9b453`.

The first authorized CI runs exposed stale parser imports, optional-key fixture compatibility errors, and three wire-level handshake failures. The fixes update the parser path, default missing key fields to None, and explicitly configure Uvicorn's HTTP/WebSocket protocols. AMD installs `pyproject_other.toml`, whose `diffusion_common` extra lacked the `websockets` dependency already present in the NVIDIA configuration; this follow-up adds it. A separate upstream test using NVIDIA cuDNN/FlashAttention now requires NVIDIA CUDA, preserving its numerical test body and assertions.

Local checks after these fixes:

- FastAPI 0.136.0, 0.137.0, and 0.141.1: 110 source-isolated authentication cases passed per version.
- FastAPI 0.162.0 / Uvicorn 0.54.0: the complete authentication test module imported and passed 110 isolated cases, with the CLI parser test deselected. GPU startup dependencies were isolated.
- With automatic WebSocket protocol selection unavailable, all three loopback handshake cases passed using the explicit protocols: missing/incorrect keys return HTTP 403 before handler entry; the correct key returns HTTP 101 and enters the handler.
- Existing shared-auth, CORS, lifespan, and application-configuration probes passed 98 cases on each of FastAPI 0.136.0 and 0.141.1.
- Platform-marker checks preserve execution on NVIDIA CUDA and skip the NVIDIA-specific test on CPU/ROCm. Its numerical body and assertions are unchanged.
- The AMD dev extras transitively include the added WebSocket dependency.
- Applicable pre-commit checks and `git diff --check` passed.

The prior official AMD run on `915a8ff3b` passed the CLI parser and HTTP/ASGI authentication cases. Official CPU CI also passed the existing shared-auth and SRT management-permission tests. Full native Windows collection stops at the Unix-only `resource` import; local isolated checks do not replace official Linux CI.

AMD FLUX.3 image-edit equality remains unresolved and is tracked in [#45847](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/45847). The same assertion fails on [upstream main with the same ROCm 10 image](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41259963770/job/124711053884). Its pixel-equality assertions are preserved.

Official CI for the latest follow-up remains pending. Prior runs hit the 120-minute trigger cooldown; rerun after 2026-11-01 07:05:42 UTC or have an authorized maintainer trigger the tests.

Repository test command for Linux:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python python3 -m pytest \
  python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_http_auth.py \
  test/registered/unit/utils/test_auth.py \
  test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_http_server_auth_levels.py \
  -q -p no:cacheprovider
```

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+)
+def test_websocket_auth_handshake_on_the_wire(token, status):
+    """Uvicorn accepts valid credentials and rejects unauthorized upgrades."""
+    app = FastAPI()
+    entered = False
+
+    @app.websocket("/stream")
+    async def stream(websocket: WebSocket):
+        nonlocal entered
+        entered = True
+        await websocket.accept()
+        await websocket.close()
+
+    add_api_key_middleware(app, api_key="user-secret", admin_api_key=None)
+    with socket.socket() as listener:
+        listener.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
+        listener.listen()
+        port = listener.getsockname()[1]
+        server = uvicorn.Server(
+            uvicorn.Config(
+                app,
+                loop="asyncio",
+                http="h11",
+                ws="websockets-sansio",
+                lifespan="off",
+                log_level="critical",
+                timeout_graceful_shutdown=1,
+            )
+        )
+        thread = threading.Thread(
+            target=server.run, kwargs={"sockets": [listener]}, daemon=True
+        )
+        thread.start()
+        try:
+            deadline = time.monotonic() + 10
+            while (
+                not server.started and thread.is_alive() and time.monotonic() < deadline
+            ):
+                time.sleep(0.01)
+            assert server.started, "Uvicorn failed to start"
+            headers = {
+                "Connection": "Upgrade",
+                "Upgrade": "websocket",
+                "Sec-WebSocket-Version": "13",
+                "Sec-WebSocket-Key": "dGhlIHNhbXBsZSBub25jZQ==",
+            }
+            if token is not None:
+                headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
+            response = httpx.get(
+                f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/stream",
+                headers=headers,
+                trust_env=False,
+                timeout=5,
+            )
+            assert response.status_code == status
+            assert entered == (status == 101)
+        finally:
+            # Let Uvicorn observe the HTTP client's closed upgrade connection.
+            deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
+            while server.server_state.connections and time.monotonic() < deadline:
+                time.sleep(0.01)
+            server.should_exit = True
+            thread.join(timeout=5)
+            assert not thread.is_alive(), "Uvicorn failed to stop"
+
